intro: Erion's Behest is a summons dispatched to promising night elf rogues operating out of Darnassus. Recognizing their budding stealthcraft, the rogue mentor Erion Shadewhisper sends them across the sea to Stormwind City to report directly to Stormwind Intelligence.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Word of your deeds has spread far and wide, friend. So far, in fact, that Stormwind Intelligence has asked for you by name.
The journey is taxing and not without peril, but an opportunity to train under SI:7 should not be taken lightly.
A new world awaits you, friend. Make your way to Old Town in Stormwind and speak with Renzik "The Shiv" at SI:7 headquarters.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have answered SI:7's calling, friend and journeyed from distant shores to join our ranks, however, there is much for you to learn.
